_what_this_is: A pull request one character away from correct on each of the three blocking rules. The checker beside it has to refuse this document, and the workflow runs it every time so that a checker gutted into a pass turns red here rather than going unnoticed. Each near miss is the mistake somebody actually makes: the issue number written without the hash that links it, and the changelog fragment written one directory away from the root the release assembly reads. The repository behind it has published, so nothing here excuses the version change.
title: Add the deterministic check over the pull request itself
body:
Closes issue 100.

The number is here and the hash is not, so nothing links this to anything.
